review_kind: Manual source-backed semantic review; no inference, source/test edits, or score changes
scope: All 18 raw model request/response pairs (10 planner, 8 responder), all coordinator events, 19 delivered texts, 20 backend attempts, and 8 effects across all four traces.

source_verification.interpretation: Comparison is to current files at review time. Later edits, including unrelated benchmark manifest changes, require their own verification; frozen run hashes remain the evaluation provenance.

summary.conclusion: All observed effects and delivered facts match these development requests. Named-place planning preserves the supplied identity in this run; raw planner narration still contains suppressed false claims.

findings.topic: Raw planner completion and stale ETA claims remain
findings.observation: Office turn2 raw reply claims navigation has started with ETA 88 minutes before execution; the actual office ETA is 29. Airport turn3 and cancellation raw replies also claim completion before their tools. These fields have no matching delivery; only post-tool grounded result text is delivered.

findings.topic: Unnecessary route ID in spoken-result text
findings.observation: The final airport response reads route ID R3. It is accurate but unrequested technical detail for the driver.

Final-text submission to first substantive response p50/p95 is 15.669/18.730 seconds (n=9); acknowledgments are 0.703/0.889 seconds (n=10). These are not acoustic speech-end or audible interruption measurements.

comparison_with_iteration2_run2: Both runs pass four backend-effect scenarios. The new trajectory fixes the earlier coincidental named-stop pass: it searches the supplied Blue Tokai name rather than a coffee category with an invented five-minute cap.
This run exercises connective normalization through search_destination(query=Blue Tokai in Indiranagar), unlike iteration2 run2, which used a category-returned canonical ID.
Fresh repeat navigation, correction suppression, grounded clarification, and cancellation remain correct on these same observed cases.
The four-case run does not exercise the added stop-free re-route cache regression or immutable-argument retry rejection; those are separate deterministic test evidence.

per_case_review.review: Correction occurs synchronously at first plan_ready, before commitment. Only turn2 dispatches; office navigation and the delivered 29-minute estimate match the backend.

delivered_texts.text: Navigation has started to the Office (Manyata Tech Park). The route is active and will take approximately 29 minutes.

per_case_review.review: All three turns contain compute_route then start_navigation; backend routes R1, R2, R3 activate airport, office, airport. Delivered 88/29-minute estimates match their respective outcomes; the last result unnecessarily reads R3.

delivered_texts.text: Navigation to Kempegowda International Airport has started. The estimated time of arrival is 88 minutes.
Navigation to the office has started. The route is active with a distance of 11.8 km and an estimated travel time of 29 minutes.
The navigation has started to Kempegowda International Airport. The route is active with route ID R3.

per_case_review.review: The supplied Blue Tokai in Indiranagar name is searched exactly and resolves to K_BLUETOKAI before add_waypoint. No find_nearby or max_detour_min is planned or executed. The 12.3-km/31-minute result and later route removal are grounded.

Blue Tokai in Indiranagar has been added as a stop. The route is active with a distance of 12.3 km and an estimated travel time of 31 minutes.
The navigation cancellation was successful. The active route to Office (Manyata Tech Park) has been removed.

per_case_review.review: The first search returns the two actual Airport Road candidates. Dependent route/start calls are skipped; the deterministic clarification names both. The explicit Starbucks follow-up computes and starts K_SBUX_AIR, and the delivered 67-minute estimate matches.

delivered_texts.text: Which place do you mean: Manipal Hospital, Old Airport Road or Starbucks, Airport Road?
Navigation has started. You are being routed to Starbucks, Airport Road, with an estimated arrival time of 67 minutes.

limitations: One run per previously inspected development case, with no held-out or generalization claim and no ablation attribution.
Fixed simulated map and tools only; no live vehicle, geocoder, microphone, STT, TTS, audio transport, road noise, or audible barge-in measurement.
Raw model claims can remain wrong even when suppression prevents user exposure. This review does not establish correct arbitrary future plans.
Local request configuration and recorded model receipts are not independent inference-process attestation.
experiment.json and all raw traces are preserved unchanged; only this review file was created.
